sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Access secure services, view your details and lodge online.

Deductions for meals, snacks, overtime meals, entertainment and functions.

The cost of food and drink during normal working hours is private and not deductible, but there are limited exceptions.

Deductions for meals you buy and eat while working overtime.

You can't claim the cost of attending functions or participating in entertainment involving food, drink or recreation.
